summary: ExchangeRight Income Fund filed an 8-K to report routine updates on its continuous private offering of common shares outstanding and issued as of May 31, 2026, as well as May 2026 dividend declarations of $0.1449 per share paid in cash or reinvested under its DRIP. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is present. The filing is an ordinary periodic update with no event-driven catalyst.
